note: Set B is better because it extracts values from the contour plots and line plots more accurately. Set A has multiple errors reading the line plots (e.g., assigning the 11000 N/m normal force to U = 9 m/s instead of U = 10 m/s) and hallucinates thrust coefficient values that only exist on the power coefficient plot (0.480, 0.420). Set B has a few inaccuracies in reading the line plots but is overall much more faithful to the data.
